en:
A naval commander based on Noshima, and the central figure among the three houses of the Murakami Navy. Contrary by nature and a born lover of war, he is famed for his valor across the Seto Inland Sea.
Persuaded by Nomi Munekatsu, he lends his strength to the Mouri Army at the Battle of Itsukushima. (Ep. 12)
From then on he fights alongside the Mouri Army. However, he does not march out for the Chikuzen Campaign, which makes Motonari and the others suspicious of him. (Ep. 19)

A naval commander based on Noshima, and the central figure among the three houses of the Murakami Navy. Contrary by nature and a born lover of war, he is famed for his valor across the Seto Inland Sea.
Persuaded by Nomi Munekatsu, he lends his strength to the Mouri Army at the Battle of Itsukushima. (Ep. 12)
From then on he fights alongside the Mouri Army. However, he does not march out for the Chikuzen Campaign, which makes Motonari and the others suspicious of him. (Ep. 19)
In truth, he has been won over by Otomo schemes and has joined the encirclement of the Mouri. He appears as reinforcements for the enemy in the Bizen Campaign, but, persuaded by the Mouri side, he joins the Mouri Army once again. (Ep. 21)

A naval commander. Of the three houses of the Murakami Navy, he leads the branch based on Innoshima.
In the Interception in Bingo, he fights off the invasion of Bingo by the Amago Army and by Sugihara Tadaoki, who has defected from the Ouchi side to the Amago side. He receives reinforcements from the Mouri clan, and from then on serves with the Mouri Army. (Ep. 8)

Elder brother of Mouri Motonari. He inherits the headship after the death of his father, Mouri Hiromoto. He then follows Ouchi Yoshioki on his march to Kyoto and fights in one region after another. Back in Aki, he fights Shishido Motoyoshi of Goryu Castle, but in the midst of it he falls ill.
(Ep. 1)

Younger brother of Mouri Okimoto, head of the Mouri clan. His childhood name is Shojumaru. He lost his mother at five and his father at ten, and was raised by Lady Sugi, who took his mother's place.

Guardian of the Mouri clan head, Komatsumaru.
In a glorious first battle, Motonari kills Takeda Motoshige, who exploits the death of Motonari's elder brother Okimoto to invade Arita Castle in Kikkawa territory. (Ep. 1)

Guardian of the Mouri clan head, Komatsumaru.
In a glorious first battle, Motonari kills Takeda Motoshige, who exploits the death of Motonari's elder brother Okimoto to invade Arita Castle in Kikkawa territory. (Ep. 1)
He weds Lady Myo, daughter of Kikkawa Kunitsune, and the Mouri leave the Ouchi camp for the Amago. (Ep. 2)
As the Amago vanguard at Kagamiyama Castle, he skillfully induces the castle to surrender. (Ep. 2)

en:
Head of the Mouri clan.
By force and cunning, he raises the Mouri, once a small house caught between the great Amago and Ouchi, into Chugoku's leading power. At Itsukushima he defeats Sue Harukata, who overthrew Ouchi Yoshitaka, then goes on to destroy the Ouchi and rival the Amago.

Making it a battle to avenge Takamoto, the Mouri Army takes the Amago seat, Gassan-Toda Castle, in fierce fighting, confines Amago head Yoshihisa and his kin in Aki and pacifies Chugoku. (Ep. 17)
